examples.input: Addition of 2 mL (NH4)2S 0.5 M to 1 mL of an unknown sample solution, results in a gray precipitate. If the sample solution is first treated with an acidified solution of H2S in 1M HCl, a black precipitate forms. After filtering the black precipitate, addition of 2 mL (NH4)2S 0.5 M to 1 mL of the filtrate does not cause any precipitations. Which of the following options can correctly describe the contents of the unknown sample solution?
